titulo_fr: Nuances et expressions : Observer les formes
titulo_es: nuances and expressions: Vocabulary and forms
intro: It interprets connotation, registration and idiomatic expressions for the context. Read the French first; open the translation when you want to check your understanding.

au pied de la lettre.en: at the foot of the letter

texto: It interprets connotation, registration and idiomatic expressions for the context. It distinguishes statements, evidence and reservations; it attributes each data to its source before making a conclusion.

Point of attention: A idiomatic expression can deviate from its literal sense; it identifies who uses it and with what intention. In this fragment, «au pied de la lettre» means «at the foot of the letter».

frases.fr: Elle rappelle que les titres accrocheurs ne doivent pas toujours être pris au pied de la lettre.
frases.es: Recuerda que los titulares llamativos no siempre deben tomarse al pie de la letra.
frases.en: Remember that striking headlines should not always be taken at the foot of the letter.

frases.fr: L'expression n'est pas un reproche adressé au public, mais une mise en garde contre les conclusions hâtives.
frases.es: La expresión no es un reproche al público, sino una advertencia contra las conclusiones precipitadas.
frases.en: The expression is not a reproach to the public, but a warning against the hasty conclusions.
